title: deptree graph.json
description: Evidence-backed dependency graph. Schema evolution is additive: new optional fields (e.g. node.vulnerabilities, node.defects, node.risk) may be added under schema_version 1.x; consumers must ignore unknown fields and unknown enum values of `relation` and `type`.

source.description: {type: git, url, clone_url, ref, subdir, commit} or {type: local, path}

generated_at.description: Only field that changes between identical scans.

roots.description: One sub-root per manifest (package.json, Dockerfile, workflow, ...).

items.description: Dependencies that could not be resolved to an exact node.

file.description: Path relative to the scanned repository's parent (starts with the project folder).

locator.description: Where in the file, e.g. packages["node_modules/express"], line 12, jobs.test.steps[0].uses

source.description: Set to 'generated-lockfile' when the lockfile was generated, not committed.

id.description: purl for packages/images/actions; app:<manifest> for roots; local-action:<path> for local actions.

ecosystem.description: npm, pypi, golang, maven, gem, composer, cargo, nuget, docker, github-actions

version.description: Exact resolved version. null when unresolved (see properties.version_unresolved): such nodes cannot be matched to CVEs exactly.

purl.description: Package URL; use this for OSV / vulnerability database queries.

scopes.description: Root-edge scopes through which the node is reachable: prod, dev, optional, peer, build, runtime, ci.

resolved.description: Download URL / source as recorded in the lockfile.

integrity.description: Lockfile hash (npm SRI, cargo/composer checksum, nuget contentHash, go.sum h1).

properties.description: Type-specific extras (tag/digest/pinned_by_digest for images, pinned_to_sha/ref_type for actions, workspace, bundled, version_unresolved, ...).

declared_range.description: Range as written by the dependent (package.json, lockfile requires, ...).
